title: Hydro Flask Insulated Mug for Coffee, Tea, Hot Chocolate - Leak-Resistant Lid, Keeps Drinks Hot

reviews_5s:
This was a gift for my husband who loves coffee. He loves it because it keeps the coffee warm for hours. The handle helps it have the feel of a coffee mug, but more insulated than a typical mug.Love this for campingUse this at work for coffee and tea. Does the job. Love that this one has handle. The size is about 1 cup of coffee size which is perfect.Great size. Function is the key. No leaking and keeps coffee hot. Tight seal. Can take it in car with me not loosing a drop.Love all things Hydroflask. These work great just as intendedI have every size of Hydroflask mug or tumbler, but this is my favorite for my morning cup of coffee. The size is perfect (not too heavy), the handle is generous enough for a four finger grasp, and the bottom is stable (unlike the tumbler, which will tip over much too easily if on an uneven/soft surface). FWIW, my husband prefers the 24 oz size, perhaps because he has much bigger hands than me--and that's the size he takes to work. I would probably take the 24 oz size to work if it fit in my cup holder, because it's also super stable. I once took the 16 oz tumbler to work and it tipped over, so that was the first and only time for that.I'm 55 years old and it's taken this long to find the perfect coffee cup! It may not be your perfect travel mug for riding in the car but for sitting at home or in the office it is an exceptional cup. It keeps my coffee piping hot so I can sit and enjoy it at my leisure without it cooling of one bit. You can literally run around the house for an hour, taking care of chores, and when you realize you forgot about your coffee and return you better be careful because it's the same temperature as when you poured it. As for the lid, the hole is large enough for the liquid to flow into you mouth without bring restricted by a tiny pin hole like typical travel mugs. Just go ahead and buy it!I bought this mug for my husband because his coffee was always getting cold since he takes so long to drink it. He was thrilled that this mug keeps his coffee hot (!) for as long as it takes him to drink it which is always way over an hour or more. And the top for this mug has an easy slide to open it unlike other mugs like the Yeti which is too difficult to force open.
So I recommend this cup. I just wish they had one that held 16 ounces with a handle; I would buy one for myself.This is without a doubt the best mug I have ever owned. It is well built, feels very solid all around, and the insulation is incredible. If I keep the lid on, a hot drink poured in the morning will stay warm all day and the outside surface never gets hot.

The lid is rubberized and grips well, enough that it definitely won't come off on its own while still being relatively easy to open with a small tab sticking out.
The underside is slightly grippy, enough that the mug won't slide on a marble countertop or glass table, and similarly the handle coating has enough friction that the mug won't tip and spill even if you have wet hands.
The lid can be taken apart in two pieces and put back for cleaning, and there aren't any places that are hard to clean or where food would stay stuck.

The only "downside" I would call out is that the mug does not fully seal even with the lid closed, there is still a small gap where liquid can flow through. This means you cannot use it as a small alternative to an insulated water bottle: do not place it in a travel bag with liquid inside, the "closed" lid only protects from spills when you walk to a different room with the mug, it will not hold its contents while traveling.

In summary: this mug was clearly designed with great attention to detail, and its insulation is like no other. I wish I had bought one earlier.Very durable product that is a must have in our house. My husband uses this daily and it keeps his coffee warm for hours.

I should have paid attention to the 1 star reviews they are 100% correct, no sealing and after a while the hot coffee turns into ice coffee.
Very disappointed and frustrated.
My best advice do not buy it.This is the stupidest product I’ve ever bought. Other reviewers commented that the cup leaks. But I didn’t really need something “leak proof” and for some reason, I thought hydroflask was a good brand. But what I’m telling you is that you can’t drink from this cup, with the lid on, without it leaking. So if you want coffee all over your shirt, go ahead. If not keep looking.I finally broke down and ordered a 24oz mug. A lot of talk about how "great" these hydro flask bottles are. If the one I got is typical, and representative of the brand, all the talk is crap. Even if they were half the price, the quality is still crap. The steel and coating is separating, handle is very weak. I expect it to snap off pretty quickly. Kept my coffee hot for about 15 minutes. My Walmart mug for $5 outshines this crap by far. Was going to get my kids some hydro flask bottles, but Walmart it is.I was hoping this mug would keep my coffee warm but the top would not stay on at all! The top does not screw on only pushes down, but the heat from the drinks causes the top to pop off. Also you cannot close the top lid only slide which causes the drink to spill because there's a hole in the top closure.My broth is cold within one hour. For the price of 30 dollars, you would think when the cup was manufactured they would have considered this. BIG NO NO DO NOT BUY!Don’t know about all the positive reviews but I can honestly say this cup is not worth the hype or money. Does not keep the coffee warm let alone hot.
